content.thinking:
I'm noting that the document is an order acknowledgement, and there's a conflict in the terms: EXW normally leaves freight to the buyer, yet the text says freight, insurance and duties are prepaid by the seller, so I'll flag that. I'm also pulling the key figures: a quantity of 5500 (the 5,500 uses a comma as a thousands separator), a unit price of 6.11 USD, a confirmed date of 2026-12-22, and an order date starting 2026-11.

The order date runs to the 18th of November 2026, and no total is printed on the document. Next I'm looking at item 00010, a 64 GB game card titled "Grand Heist 5".

statements.text_en: Delivery terms are EXW Boise, ID per Sales Agreement PC-0011-2023, section 4.1. DDP is not agreed. Freight, insurance and duties are prepaid by Seller and added to the invoice.

verdict.summary_en: Order acknowledgement OA26961038 from Boise Semiconductor Inc. to Soony Interactive GmbH for PO 4500318794 dated 2026-11-18. It confirms one line: 5,500 units of CMP-GAM-002 (Game Card 64 GB – Grand Heist 5) at 6.11 USD, for delivery on 2026-12-22. Terms are EXW Boise, payment NET30. The document is clean, with no handwriting or corrections.
red_flags: The delivery terms contradict themselves. They say EXW Boise and that DDP is not agreed. They also say freight, insurance and duties are prepaid by Seller and added to the invoice. Under EXW the buyer normally arranges and pays freight, so the invoice may include freight charges the buyer did not expect.
The document shows no issue date of its own and no line total. The only date for the order is the PO date, 2026-11-18.
observations: Clean typed PDF with no handwriting, stamps, signatures or crossed-out values.
The unit price is printed without a price unit, such as per piece, and no total value is stated.
The quantity is printed without a unit of measure.
